Form No. 3
G. 32,000-1-30

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
（印：162 File No.
DATE 8. 0. 30）
S.B. 1 Station,
Date August 23 1930

REPORT

CONFIDENTIAL
Subject (in full) complaint against C.D.C.116

Made by Cl.Asst. Tan Shao-liang Forwarded by

(I)
During an interview with Col. Yuan Liang in his office
at 4 p.m. August 22 in connection with the question of
handing over of prisoners, the Colonel handed me the attached
slip in his own handwriting bearing the name of Ho Zung
Jui 何仁瑞, a Cantonese C.D.C. of Hongkew Station, who,
he states, is implicated in the murder of C.D.S.I. Ling
Ying Ziang, Colonel Yuan states that the C.D.C. was formerly
a notorious loafer and requested that he be arrested and
handed over to him. I replied that the murder occurred in
the Settlement and that if the Chinese Police have any
information or evidence against the C.D.C., they should
forward it to you for investigation.

Tan Shaoliang
Clerical Assistant.

(批：II
Correct
what was
reply.
R.W.)

D.C. (Cr.& Sp. Br).

(批：III
Col. Yuan did not make a definite
reply yesterday but I told him to-day that
nothing can be done until he forwarded the
necessary evidence. He replied he will do so to
you direct. Tan 23/8/30)

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
（印：162 档案号。
日期 30.8.）
虹口巡捕房，
日期 1930年8月23日

报告

机密
事由（全称） 针对华籍巡捕 C.D.C.116 的投诉

由 文书助理 谭绍良 提交 转呈人

(I)
8月22日下午4时，我在袁良上校办公室就移交囚犯一事与其面谈期间，上校递给我一张附上的便条，系其亲笔书写，上面写有虹口巡捕房华籍巡捕何仁瑞（Ho Zung Jui，广东人）的名字。上校称，此人牵涉到杀害华籍警探凌英祥（Ling Ying Ziang）一案。袁上校指出，该华籍巡捕从前是个臭名昭著的游手好闲之徒，并要求将其逮捕并移交给上校。我回答说，谋杀案发生在租界内，如果中国警方掌握有关该华籍巡捕的任何情报或证据，应将其送交贵处以供调查。

谭绍良
文书助理。

（批注：II
回复内容正确。
R.W.）

刑事与特种支部副督察长。

（批注：III
袁上校昨日未作明确答复，但我今日告知他，在他移送必要证据之前，无法采取任何行动。他答复说将直接向你方移送。谭 1930年8月23日）
